'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Sean Miller DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Sean Miller]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name Walking. Sean Miller, 2014 Worlds Day 2, 2013 form. Username blank.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
